decision.rationale: TXN-007999 (146.89 EUR, SALTMARSH JOURNEYS, card CRD-000126) posted on 2026-08-06. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-29, 84 days later, so it falls inside the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation AUTH-008199 shows entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure AUTHENTICATED, CVV MATCH, response APPROVED and no fraud flag. Under unauthorised-3ds-authenticated, an online payment the cardholder confirmed with 3-D Secure and that has no fraud flag counts as made by the cardholder, and the matching security code supports this. The cardholder's statement that they do not recognise the payment does not outweigh this record, so the dispute is declined.

proposed_actions.reason: You confirmed this online payment with 3-D Secure authentication, the correct card security code was given, and our fraud screening did not flag it. Under our policy, it counts as a payment you made.
